children: The Australian economy grew 0.4% qoq in Q2 2026, accelerating from a 0.3% expansion in Q1, which had marked the slowest growth in a year.
The latest result also exceeded market expectations of 0.3%.
Growth was supported by pockets of private demand, partly met through higher imports, and stronger mining exports aided by inventory drawdowns.
Annual GDP growth eased to 2.1% from 2.5% in Q1, the slowest pace in three quarters, but still above the 1.8% consensus.

title: Australia Q2 GDP Growth Tops Estimates
